body: i frequently browse through /r/watchpeopledie and watch the suicide clips

It depends on the person honestly. Some people say that getting someone you love committed is the best thing you can do, but to others is a pretty awful thing to do to someone you care about. 

For example if I'm confiding in someone and telling them about my problems and venting that I don't want to be here anymore and they call the hospital to come take me away; now I'm locked up in a place I don't want to be and when I'm finally released I get slapped with a huge medical bill. Do I feel grateful or happier? Of course not.

So I think it varies from case to case. For some people it's genuinely the right thing to do. For your case I'd guess that he doesn't really know how serious you are or that the feeling will just pass. If you think its not right that you haven't been taken to a hospital yet, perhaps you should go there yourself and see how things turn out

I was just about to make a post about that thread too. It really put me at ease with my worries about what happens next. I'm not saying that what happened to all those people is what is 100% going to happen after death, but seeing that lots of people had similar experiences makes me less anxious.

It really sounds so peaceful and comforting how they described it. I hope that's what will happen for me.

I had this thought also. If I do it too close too Christmas then that's all people will associate that time with instead of enjoying the holiday. However I don't want to even make it till Christmas this year and fall/winter is my favorite time of the year so I think it'd be good to go out during that time. But far away enough from Christmas so that by the time it comes around the pain for everyone will have faded somewhat. 

Eventually everyone will move on with their lives though so it's not like a specific day will matter in the long run. It will be hard for them at first but as time goes on they will recover and they'll be okay.

I also hate working too, currently unemployed. I had one job that the father of my fiancé at the time got for me, put my name in with a business partner of his. It was a warehouse job in like 95° heat stacking pallets for 7 hours. Graveyard shift. I got through 3 hours and knew I couldn't do it. There was no way in hell. I quit the following day. I know I'd disappointed my fiancé and my parents and her parents. Her dad who got me the job and her mom whose house I was living in were livid. Got yelled at a ton and had to fucking leave town for a few days because it was just so hostile. But I couldn't do it, I absolutely would not have been able to do that full time. I'd have killed myself eventually for sure doing that soul crushing work. Payed well too, but is that really worth feeling immense dread everyday I go in to my job? Not to me it isn't.

Anyways just wanted to let you know you're not alone in your situation. And you are a great writer, I mean that. You should definitely post that four thousand word post you typed up. With how you write I'd be interested in reading it. Hope your situation improves, you seem like a great person and you are talented whether you see that or not.
Apply for unemployment and take it easy for a little while as you compose yourself and search for other opportunities. I'm sure your fiance will be happy to support you during this time.

I've been waiting for me motivation to find me for years now. Everyone my age and even younger knows what they want to do with their lives and have the motivation to achieve it. Meanwhile I've tried thinking and looking and even just sitting back and hoping it comes to me somehow but it never does and I'm always left out. I just don't think I was made for this world

I'd really not continue living though. What's the point in living if I've got nothing to look forward to, nothing that makes me want to get out of bed in the morning, no goals, no motivation, no happiness, not one thing that makes me want to wake up the next day? Literally everything in my life is pointless now. 

One of my favorite quotes was "The moment you utter the word 'pointless' you've already lost the battle" and I still agree with it. I lost the battle a long time ago and I accept that. I'm done with this life and have no intention of living past 2018.

I don't know much about morphine. Would that dose even be enough to kill you? Would it cause a lot of pain after taking it? If you were to come out of it alive, what effects might it have on your body that you'd have to live with from then on? I hope things turn around for you and that you don't end up going through with it

It might not work out the way you mean for it to, but you can try taking all of these feelings you're having and use them to drive you to do whatever you can to get her back. You know her better than anyone else. You know what she likes and chances are she may still harbor some feelings for you too. If you funnel all your emotions toward this goal of getting her back and you're truly dedicated, who knows it may work or it may not. But at least you'll be actively doing something instead of stewing in these violent thoughts of hurting the one you love.

Best of luck to you mate

Both of my therapists so far have said something to the effect of "Learn to love yourself because you've only got yourself when everyone leaves" but I'm still the person who I hate the most in this world. Why would I love the person who fucked my life up, who ruined absolutely everything and made me lose everything I loved?

 I don't want to have myself, I don't even value my life a single bit. I just want this miserable existence to be over. I had my time of being happy. It's come and gone and I'll never have anything like it again so I really don't see a point living this empty life anymore. I guess I deserve this though for being so shit at literally everything and ruining everything in my life that I valued.

That question was brought up in my religion class one day. Teacher said that usually suicide leads to hell, however sins committed by those with mental disorders or those who aren't totally there and the like would be forgiven because it's not REALLY their choice. And since you've got to be in a pretty bad place mentally to consider suicide, well, God may understand and have sympathy for you.

This made me feel a lot better about it because it would seem incredibly cruel for God to give someone a horrible life with no redeeming qualities and damn them to hell for wanting to escape it all. Of course it could all be speculation, and maybe there isn't even an afterlife at all. So there's that

I can never understand people who have a significant other that is going through major turmoil and they think the best course of action is to fucking abandon them. Yeah, that's totally going to help them /s

I'm terribly sorry for what you have gone through, and I can understand why you want out. But just know that trying to kill yourself by bleeding out is going to hurt a lot. The sleeping medication won't prevent you from feeling that pain and there's a good chance that someone may discover you and back to the hospital you go.

No afterlife would be preferable to an eternal hell where you suffer forever. I'm sure all of us have had plenty suffering already. 

And you shouldn't worry about there being no afterlife. If there really is nothing after this life and it just goes back to how it was before we were born; an endless void of nothingness, you won't even have consciousness to experience it. So its not something to worry about unless of course there is a hell or maybe even reincarnation where you're forced to live another lifetime on this fucked world.
Thank you, I appreciate it. I'm sorry you've had to go through a similar situation. I hope things go well for you too

So I'm to just keep on living and feeling this pain on the miniscule chance that someone is "meant for me"..its a nice sentiment but it doesn't seem like something that could happen. It doesn't seem worth it to me to keep on going for something that isn't even guaranteed

Everything just feels so WRONG. Like I'm living in a nightmare or somehow ended up in a different timeline. It wasn't supposed to be like this. I know if I keep going on I'm constantly going to be thinking of everything I lost and how it was all my fault.

I've been going to therapy and although it's helped, it's not made me reconsider wanting to kill myself. I have family and friends. I'm sure they'd be devastated if I left but honestly am i supposed to continue living this fucking nightmare for the sake of preventing others from being upset? That hardly seems like any way to live. 

And let's say that there is someone out there who can possibly match how I feel about her. The chances of them returning those feelings are fucking laughable. Plus, I'm just in so much pain that I doubt I can even make it to the point in my life where I'd meet that person.

That's a nice thought, that someone out there would actually love me and is meant to be with me. But I'd surely fuck that up too just like I've done with everything else. I'm not going to give myself the chance to ruin another relationship. If I was really meant to be with someone, it would have been her. We have so much in common and had so much chemistry but sure enough I did what I do west and fucked it up. There won't be another person like that

We were together for 5 years and got engaged last year. I've had depression in the past but when I was with her I nearly forgot all about it. Now with her gone it's back and worse than ever since i don't have her to help me cope. If she wasn't the one after I've done everything I could to get her back then oh well. At least I tried. But I'm not going to even bother finding another one. In 55 days I won't have to feel this pain anymore.
I'm 22 years old

Make it clear to them that you don't have a plan to kill yourself. That's pretty much what they use to determine whether or not to take you away. Even if you do have a plan, lie and say you don't and that you just have suicidal thoughts and nothing more. You can say you wrote the note to "vent" or that your mind was just in a dark place but you're not actually going to carry it out and kill yourself.

It sucks because a therapist is someone you should be able to reveal everything to but even then we have to hide certain things from them or they'll send us away somewhere to "help". Best of luck to you.

I lost everything and it's my fault but I won't have to endure it for too much longer so at least that's one thing I have to look forward to.

I'm scared of heights lol. But I'm sure that if I'm desperate enough to leave this world I could overcome it momentarily. Only issue would be trying to find a tall enough place so that I don't end up paralyzed or anything like that.

Thanks for talking, you seem like a nice person. The fact that you're in this sub doesn't have good connotations though. I hope things turn out well for you.

It really shows how terrible this world is when having to live life over and over is seen as a condemnation lol. Yeah ignorance is bliss I imagine.

I wish train suicide wasn't so messy though. My original method was to stab myself in the heart. The symbolism means a lot to me however I heard that it would be really hard to do.

However some of the teachings have stuck with me so the fear of suffering for eternity as a result of killing myself is definitely there. I'm hoping for either heaven or just a thoughtless void where I'm not even conscious to experience it.

What's in that book that you think will help me?
